lead: A `-p nvs-stdlib` test cannot read which class a member threw off `nvs_runtime::call`.
body: That function answers `Result<Value, i32>`, so a `match` on `Fault::Thrown(class, message)` does not compile at all, and `ctx.take_pending()` gives the message alone — the class sits in a pending slot no test reaches without installing an exception class table first. Assert the sentence from Rust and pin the class from the `.nvst` or hostile case that catches it by name, the way `tests/hostile/core/Cli/select/01-a-menu-nobody-can-answer.nvs` catches `LogicError`.
